poems.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
poems.text:
Twinkle, twinkle little star, how I wonder what you are.
Up above the world so high, like a diamond in the sky.
Twinkle, twinkle little star, how I wonder what you are.

poems.title: One Two Zoo
poems.text:
One, two, one, two lets visit the zoo
Three, four, three, four hear the lion roar
Five, six, five, six watch the monkey tricks
Seven, eight, seven, eight peacock looks so great
Nine, ten, nine, ten we shall come again.

poems.title: Two Little Hands
poems.text:
Two little hands go Clap clap clap
Two little feet go Tap tap tap
Two little eyes That open wide
One little head Nods side to side

poems.title: Bits of Paper
poems.text:
Bits of paper, Bits of paper
Lying on the floor, Lying on the floor
Makes the place untidy, Makes the place untidy
Pick them up, Pick them up
Collect all the papers, Collect all the papers
Where shall we throw? Where shall we throw?
Throw them in the dustbin, Throw them in the dustbin
Now the place is clean, Now the place is clean

poems.title: Once a Lion Caught a Mouse
poems.text:
Once a lion caught a mouse. The mouse begged the lion not to eat him. Someday, he said, he would help the lion. The lion set the mouse free.
One day, the lion got caught in a hunter's net. The mouse came to help the lion. He cut the net with his sharp teeth. The lion was set free. The lion and the mouse became good friends.

poems.title: I Have a Toothbrush Neat and Gay
poems.text:
I have a toothbrush, neat and gay,
To brush my teeth with, everyday.
I brush them each morning,
Then I brush them each night;
Till all are shining, Clean and bright.

poems.title: Polly Put the Kettle On
poems.text:
Polly, put the kettle on,
Polly, put the kettle on,
Polly, put the kettle on, We'll all have tea.
Sukey, take it off again,
Sukey, take it off again,
Sukey, take it off again, They've all gone away.
Blow the fire and make the toast,
Put the muffins on to roast,
Blow the fire and make the toast, We'll all have tea.

poems.title: Pussy Cat Pussy Cat
poems.text:
Pussy cat, pussy cat, Where have you been?
"I've been to London to Look at the Queen."
Pussy cat, pussy cat, What did you there?
"I frightened a little mouse Under the chair."

poems.title: Five Little Ducks
poems.text:
Five little ducks went swimming one day
Over the hill and far away
Mother duck said, "Quack quack quack quack"
And only four little ducks came back!
Four little ducks went swimming one day
Over the hill and far away
Mother duck said, "Quack quack quack quack"
And only three little ducks came back!

poems.title: Little Jack Horner
poems.text:
Little Jack Horner
Sat in a corner,
Eating his Christmas pie;
He put in his thumb,
And he pulled out a plum,
And said, "What a good boy am I!"

poems.title: See Me
poems.text:
See me skip, see me run,
I am going to school Like everyone.
See me shout, See me wave,
I am off to school Bye, everyone.
See me hug, See me dance,
I see my friends Hello, everyone!

poems.title: I Have Two Hands
poems.text:
I have two arms that swing like this,
I have two hands that clap like this, Clap, Clap, Clap.
I have little fingers that wriggle like this, Wriggle, Wriggle, Wriggle.
I have two legs that jump like this, Jump, Jump, Jump.
I have two feet that march like this, March, March, March.
